# launchdarkly_observability_filter_settings (Resource)

Provides a LaunchDarkly observability filter settings resource.

~> **Beta:** This resource uses a beta API. Beta resources may change or be removed in future versions.

-> **Note:** Observability filter settings require a personal API access token, or an OAuth token with the `observability` scope. Service tokens are not supported.

This resource manages the observability ingestion settings of a LaunchDarkly project: per-product rate limits and the order in which `launchdarkly_observability_filter_rule` rules run.

Each project has exactly one filter settings object. Destroying this resource removes all rate limits and leaves rule orders unchanged; rules leave the order when they are deleted.

-> **Note:** A product listed in `rule_order` is managed authoritatively. A rule of that product that is not in the list does not run, and a rule created outside Terraform (for example in the LaunchDarkly UI) appears as drift in `terraform plan` and is removed from the order on the next apply. Reference rules by their resource (`launchdarkly_observability_filter_rule.example.key`) so that Terraform creates them before it sets the order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "launchdarkly_observability_filter_rule" "drop_health_checks" {
  project_key  = launchdarkly_project.example.key
  key          = "drop-health-checks"
  product_type = "logs"
  name         = "Drop health check logs"
  query        = "route=/healthz"
  operation    = "exclude"
}

resource "launchdarkly_observability_filter_rule" "sample_debug_logs" {
  project_key  = launchdarkly_project.example.key
  key          = "sample-debug-logs"
  product_type = "logs"
  name         = "Drop 90% of debug logs"
  query        = "level=debug"
  operation    = "exclude"
  rate         = 0.9
}

resource "launchdarkly_observability_filter_settings" "example" {
  project_key = launchdarkly_project.example.key

  # Omitted products have no limit.
  minute_rate_limits = {
    logs   = 100000
    traces = 20000
  }

  # Terraform owns the logs order: only these rules run, in this order.
  # Products that are not listed keep the order set in LaunchDarkly.
  rule_order = {
    logs = [
      launchdarkly_observability_filter_rule.drop_health_checks.key,
      launchdarkly_observability_filter_rule.sample_debug_logs.key,
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) The project key. A change in this field will force the destruction of the existing resource and the creation of a new one.

### Optional

- `minute_rate_limits` (Attributes) Per-product limits on how many items LaunchDarkly ingests per minute. A product you omit, or omitting the whole attribute, means no limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--minute_rate_limits))
- `rule_order` (Attributes) Per-product rule order, as lists of rule keys. Only the products you list are managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_order))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project key.

<a id="nestedatt--minute_rate_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `minute_rate_limits`

Optional:

- `errors` (Number) The maximum number of errors ingested per minute. Omit for no limit.
- `logs` (Number) The maximum number of logs ingested per minute. Omit for no limit.
- `metrics` (Number) The maximum number of metrics ingested per minute. Omit for no limit.
- `sessions` (Number) The maximum number of sessions ingested per minute. Omit for no limit.
- `traces` (Number) The maximum number of traces ingested per minute. Omit for no limit.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_order"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_order`

Optional:

- `errors` (List of String) The keys of the errors filter rules to run, in evaluation order. When set, this list is authoritative: any other errors rule, including one created in the LaunchDarkly UI, is removed from the order and stops running. Omit to leave the errors order unmanaged.
- `logs` (List of String) The keys of the logs filter rules to run, in evaluation order. When set, this list is authoritative: any other logs rule, including one created in the LaunchDarkly UI, is removed from the order and stops running. Omit to leave the logs order unmanaged.
- `metrics` (List of String) The keys of the metrics filter rules to run, in evaluation order. When set, this list is authoritative: any other metrics rule, including one created in the LaunchDarkly UI, is removed from the order and stops running. Omit to leave the metrics order unmanaged.
- `sessions` (List of String) The keys of the sessions filter rules to run, in evaluation order. When set, this list is authoritative: any other sessions rule, including one created in the LaunchDarkly UI, is removed from the order and stops running. Omit to leave the sessions order unmanaged.
- `traces` (List of String) The keys of the traces filter rules to run, in evaluation order. When set, this list is authoritative: any other traces rule, including one created in the LaunchDarkly UI, is removed from the order and stops running. Omit to leave the traces order unmanaged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# LaunchDarkly observability filter settings can be imported using the project key
terraform import launchdarkly_observability_filter_settings.example example-project
```
